name: mcp-doctor
description: mcp-doctor: lint, fix, fuzz and guard MCP servers from inside Claude Code

plugins.name: mcp-doctor
plugins.description: Lint the MCP server you're building for what breaks the agent calling it, fix what it finds, and, with your OK, fuzz it for a SHIP / FIX-FIRST / BLOCK verdict. Python, TypeScript and Go.

plugins.name: mcp-doctor-guard
plugins.description: Guard Claude Code's own tools: hold a secret about to be sent out, or a write to .git hooks/config or shell rc files, after the session read outside content.
